messages:
elaine: Quick bring-up for cust-entangler LoRA onto oak-13b-v2.1. Quick-eval shows token-id shifts and int4 regression.
mario: Short summary?
elaine: Their tokenizer adds <CUSTID> and reassigns ~10 high ids. If we splice weights without reindex, currency and some punctuation split.
sara: Ran token_diff: `$` base->[2505] candidate->[63,4007] on ~0.4% of samples — explains spacing.
aj: Any runtime errors?
sara: Saw kv_cache mismatch when testing 6k context: adjusted model.config.max_position_embeddings to 8192 fixed it.
mario: Eval numbers?
elaine: Baseline oak-13b fp16 EM=0.84 F1=0.91; merged fp16 EM=0.82 F1=0.89; merged int4 EM=0.76 F1=0.86.
aj: Failing example?
sara: input: "Invoice total: $99.00"
baseline: "Total: $99.00"
merged-int4: "Total 99.00 dollars"
mario: Two remediation paths: (A) re-index LoRA to base tokenizer (accurate, more work), (B) add preprocess/postprocess token collapse for known splits (fast).
ej: eval-bot: ran quant_sim per-channel symmetric/asymmetric; symmetric int4 EM drop -0.09, asymmetric -0.05. QAT sim (300 steps) projects -0.03. Artifacts: /artifacts/entangler/1755567899/quant_sim.json
sara: Pushed preprocess that collapses [63,4007] -> "$" for eval; merged-int4 EM improved 0.76->0.79.
aj: Proposal: canary merged-fp16 (5%) while we fix int4. Fallback if EM_drop >= 0.04.
deploy-bot: Canary started: entangler-lora-fp16 -> dedicated/pool-12 (5%). Fallback policy EM_drop>=0.04 -> revert to oak-13b.
mario: Actions: (1) sara: expand preprocess for other known splits, (2) kevin (assign later): attempt token-aligned remerge or QAT, (3) aj: monitor canary and alerts. Reopen with artifacts when ready. :thumbsup:
